metadata.author: transcribed from live/runs by expansion agent
metadata.key_test: Complexity-capacity matching when P1 ERODES post-transition; Mod8 (violence risk vs agency); Mod2/Safeguard E correct null on resources; Safeguard C conditioned on founding P1; Mod10 porosity-with-backstop.
metadata.notes: Run4 Case 13. WGI cited on World Bank estimate scale (-2.5 to +2.5), per run; differs from the 0-100 .SC vintage of expansion_batch1 exemplars. Most pillar values are ordinal/estimated in the run, not cardinal.

pre_event.event_description: Democratic transition: institutional replacement plus extension of governance to the entire population (managed-complexity increase). High-for-region founding institutional quality.

context.backstop_details: Strong founding constitution, independent judiciary, free press, Zondo Commission, and Constitutional Court (which jailed Zuma) act as a constitutional backstop. Nine-province quasi-federal system is the Mod10 porosity channel.

data_gaps: rule_of_law (1996 estimate not given in run)
resource_rents_pct_gdp (run gives ordinal range ~4-7% of GDP, mineral rents <4%; no single point)
South Africa.notes: Founding (1996) values: Government Effectiveness approx 1.0 and Control of Corruption approx 0.87 were both series maxima (estimate scale). High-for-region at founding. Control of Corruption percentile rank was ~76th in 1996. Resource rents ~4-7% of GDP (mineral rents <4%) -> far below the 30%-of-GDP LIVE threshold, so Safeguard E does NOT trigger.

a_trajectory_ranking.prediction: P1 declines post-transition; outcome below the high-P1 cases (Germany/UK/Belgium) but NO state collapse, because founding institutional design sets a survival floor.
a_trajectory_ranking.basis: Complexity-capacity thesis: governance extended to entire population while institutional capacity eroded (state capture); founding P1 high.
a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: State collapse, or trajectory matching/exceeding the high-P1 cases.

b_violence.prediction: Very high violence RISK, but communal/criminal/opportunistic and NOT state-perpetrated, NOT secessionist.
b_violence.agency_note: Mod8: this predicts RISK, not AGENCY. The state is not the violence agent.
b_violence.falsification_condition: South Africa remains low-violence, OR the violence is state-perpetrated/secessionist.

c_convergence.prediction: Complexity-capacity mismatch: capacity lags complexity expansion; wide pillar spread signals vulnerability.
c_convergence.basis: Governance extended to whole population (complexity up) while WGI capacity fell.
c_convergence.falsification_condition: Capacity keeps pace with complexity; narrow pillar spread.

d_failure_dimension.prediction: P1 (state capture) + P4 (economic structure / labour market) mismatch -- NOT a resource curse or a P1-floor failure.
d_failure_dimension.note: Most exposed to post-hoc coding bias. Mod2 (Safeguard E) should produce a clean null on resources.
d_failure_dimension.falsification_condition: Binding constraint turns out to be resource dependence or a P1 floor breach.

e_fragment_count.prediction: No territorial fragmentation; state stays intact.

f_reversal_risk.prediction: Low-to-moderate reversal risk; under-delivery produces ELECTORAL TURNOVER, not authoritarian reversal, because founding P1 is high. Safeguard C must be conditioned on baseline P1; Mod7 (Bangladesh/Safeguard C analogy) should NOT trigger (no high-growth bargain).

g_suppression_mechanism.classification: N/A -- not a suppression case (Mod6: centripetal / integrating-expanding).

h_substate_turbulence.prediction: Nine-province quasi-federal system is a porosity channel (provincial coalitions diverge from the national GNU) with the constitution and Constitutional Court as the Mod10 backstop. Mod9 not applicable (no re-suppression).
h_substate_turbulence.falsification_condition: Provincial divergence escapes the constitutional backstop.

South Africa.outcome_summary: P1 eroded multi-decade (Zuma/state-capture era ~2009-2018): Government Effectiveness from ~1.0 (1996) to negative by 2023; Control of Corruption percentile rank ~76th (1996) -> 43.9 (2022) -> ~45.8 (2023). 2024 WGI estimates: RoL 0.02, GE -0.23/-0.26, CoC -0.19. Fell ~40 places on the Fragile States Index since 2007, into 'Warning' (not 'Alert'/'Critical'). High violence RISK realized as communal/criminal violence; no state collapse; democratic turnover.
key_events: July 2021 Gauteng/KwaZulu-Natal unrest (~350 deaths; govt tally 337 -- 79 Gauteng, 258 KZN; ~R50bn cost; worst violence since apartheid)
Recurrent xenophobic waves (2008, 2015, 2019, 2021-22, 2026) and chronic service-delivery protests
Q2 2024 youth (15-24) unemployment 60.8%; expanded unemployment ~42%; Gini ~0.63 (world's highest)
2024 election: ANC falls to 40.2% (from 57.5% in 2019), loses majority for first time since apartheid, forms Government of National Unity with DA (21.8%); MK 14.6%

a_trajectory.evidence: GE ~1.0 (1996) -> negative by 2023; CoC percentile ~76th -> 43.9 (2022); fell ~40 FSI places since 2007 into 'Warning' -- but no collapse.
a_trajectory.explanation: P1 declined and outcome sits below the high-P1 cases, yet founding institutional design held the survival floor exactly as predicted.

b_violence.evidence: July 2021 unrest killed ~350 (worst since apartheid); recurrent xenophobic waves -- communal/criminal, not state-perpetrated, not secessionist.
b_violence.explanation: Mod8 correctly classified SA as high-violence-RISK but not state-perpetrated; high risk realized without the state as agent.
b_violence.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28: focus=South Africa pre-P1=0.608 -> LOW risk (MI v1, anchored)

c_convergence.evidence: Governance extended to whole population while WGI capacity eroded -- 'capacity lagged complexity expansion'.
c_convergence.explanation: Clearest illustration of the complexity-capacity thesis; wide pillar spread (P1 down, P4 catastrophic labour market) signalled vulnerability.

d_failure_dimension.evidence: Binding constraint = declining P1 (state capture) + catastrophic labour market (60.8% youth unemployment, Gini ~0.63); resource rents ~4-7% of GDP.
d_failure_dimension.explanation: P1+P4 mismatch, not a resource curse; Mod2/Safeguard E correctly produced a null on resources (below 30% threshold). [STRICT RE-CODE per run6 §3(d): post-hoc 'primary dimension' identification invites confirmation bias; coded PARTIAL under strict standards.]
d_failure_dimension.computed_config: South Africa: P4=0.79, P3=0.63, P1=0.61, P5=0.56 | all pillars >= median -> no binding vulnerability (management-load/high-capacity case; relatively-lowest P5=0.56)

e_fragment_count.evidence: No state collapse; intact state with provincial coalitions diverging from the national GNU.
e_fragment_count.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28 (outcome judgment preserved; safeguard re-evaluated on real data)

f_reversal_risk.evidence: 30 years without authoritarian reversal; 2024 produced a democratic turnover (ANC 40.2%, GNU with DA) -- the opposite of reversal.
f_reversal_risk.explanation: Naive Safeguard C reading (under-delivery -> reversal) NOT borne out; high founding P1 produced electoral turnover. Confirms conditioning Safeguard C on baseline P1; Mod7 correctly did not trigger.
f_reversal_risk.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28 (outcome judgment preserved; safeguard re-evaluated on real data)

g_suppression.explanation: Not a suppression case (Mod6: centripetal / complexity-expansion).
g_suppression.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28 (outcome judgment preserved; safeguard re-evaluated on real data)

h_turbulence.evidence: Nine-province quasi-federal porosity (ANC-EFF in Gauteng, MK plurality in KZN) held under the national constitution/Constitutional Court backstop.
h_turbulence.explanation: Mod10/Safeguard I (porosity-with-backstop) fits SA; Mod9 not applicable (no re-suppression).

analysis.overall_assessment: All applicable predictions consistent with the framework; LIVE outperforms STATIC (Mod8 risk-vs-agency, Mod2 resource null). South Africa avoided collapse despite declining P1 because its founding institutional design set a survival floor.
new_failure_modes_discovered: P1 can ERODE rather than rise after a democratic transition; capacity lagging complexity expression appears as communal/criminal violence, not state collapse.
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Founding institutional design sets a survival floor that is independent of subsequent P1 erosion; under-delivery under high founding P1 yields electoral turnover, not authoritarian reversal.
proposed_framework_modifications: Condition Safeguard C on founding P1 (under-delivery need not cause reversal when founding institutional quality is high).
Promote candidate Safeguard I (porosity-with-backstop) from candidate to working safeguard (confirmed 5/5 in Run 4).
analysis.baseline_impact: Conditioning Safeguard C on founding P1 is a refinement that needs the 20-case baseline check before adoption.
analysis.strict_recode_note: Strict re-code applied per run6 (post-hoc d-dimension -> PARTIAL; narrow-gap a-trajectory annotated with Mod4). Honest aggregate target ~62-78%.
analysis.phase3_note: Migrated to MI v1 + Data API references. a_trajectory/c_convergence auto-derived from real re-scored data (Mod4-gated); b/d/e/f/g/h preserved as judgment.
analysis.judgment_refresh_note: Judgment verdicts (b/d/e/f/g/h) re-examined against MI v1 real-data scores on 2026-06-28: no verdict flips (directional readings robust to the legacy->anchored vintage change); b risk-levels refreshed from real pre-P1, d augmented with the real config (weakest pillar flagged as a binding vulnerability only when below median), safeguards re-evaluated.
